question: Get details of repositories that use specific feature toggle libraries. For each repository, include the full name with owner, hosting platform type, size in bytes, primary programming language, fork source name (if any), last update timestamp, the artifact and library names of the feature toggle used, and the library's programming languages. filtered_deps AS (
    SELECT d.project_name, d.project_id, d.dependency_name, d.dependency_platform, d.dependency_kind, p.id AS project_internal_id, p.repository_id, p.platform AS project_platform
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.libraries_io.dependencies` d
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.libraries_io.projects` p ON d.project_name = p.name AND d.platform = p.platform
    WHERE d.dependency_name IN (SELECT artifact_name FROM feature_toggle_libs)
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    pr.repository_name_with_owner,
    pr.repository_host_type,
    pr.repository_size * 1024 AS size_in_bytes,
    pr.repository_language,
    pr.repository_fork_source_name_with_owner,
    pr.repository_updated_timestamp AS last_updated_timestamp,
    fd.dependency_name AS artifact_name,
    ftl.library_name,
    ftl.library_languages
FROM filtered_deps fd
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.libraries_io.projects_with_repository_fields` pr ON fd.project_internal_id = pr.id
JOIN feature_toggle_libs ftl ON fd.dependency_name = ftl.artifact_name AND LOWER(fd.dependency_platform) = LOWER(ftl.platform)
WHERE pr.repository_name_with_owner IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY pr.repository_name_with_owner, fd.dependency_name
